caseName: Jones & Laughlin Steel Corp. v. National Labor Relations Board
caseNameFull: Jones & Laughlin Steel Corp. v. National Labor Relations Board
attorneys: Messrs. Alfred C. Kammer and John C. Bane, Jr. for petitioner. Assistant Solicitor General Cox, Mr. Alvin J. Rockwell, Misses Ruth Weyand and Ida Klaus for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit denied.

The Chief Justice and Mr. Justice Roberts took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
